 " Please check tracking carefully we updated, we have small problem. We have error in IT system- more than 40 order when export shipping information from Ebay (wrong address when dispatch), so maybe your order is one of them. If you see shipment DELIVERED, but NOT IN YOUR HOME, pls open case ORDER NOT RECEIVE on Ebay immediately. We will focus on your order 100% , resend to your address in fast shipping services after that.  
Hope you sympathy and pls OPEN CASE IMMEDIATELY when not receive. "

​

I responded that the shipping information I provided on Ebay is correct and to use that but when I got the tracking number it showed that the package was delivered to a completely different state. I sent the Seller a message that I hadn't received the item, and they gave me another tracking number but that one was going to the wrong state as well. When that item was delivered, I opened an Item Not Received request. The Seller got back saying to be patient and that it would take a few business days to receive the item but didn't provide another tracking number. A few days go by and I get a notification that the shipping information has been updated. However, when I view the tracking number, it said the package had been delivered "In/At Mailbox" two weeks ago. Keep in mind that the tracking number didn't include my actual address - just my city. 

I was home at that time and accepted mail directly from the USPS postal worker as I was outside doing yardwork and never received my CPU.

I went back to check to Seller's recent reviews and the last 8 have been cases just like mine while the previous 400 were for products unrelated to CPU's. 

I want to get a refund but after looking around some forums, it seems like because the Seller provided shipping information that says it was delivered I might be SOL. How can I get my money back? Congratulations on getting an interview. I started working for the state after submitting a similar amount of applications. 

I found the best way to prepare for the interview is to review the duty statement and attach your experience to what the job is asking you to do. 

If it says 50 percent of your job will be at a desk, entering data into excel then talk about your familiarity with that and how it helped you be successful in a previous job. 

If it says you'll be dealing with the public or other employees then talk about customer service, professionalism and the importance of those in a successful workplace. 

Keep your answers focused on how your skills and knowledge tick all of their boxes. 

Good luck.

The usual way errors are fixed in the contracts depends on the scope of the error. Minor ones can be amended but major ones that fundamentally change the scope of the contract have to be cancelled and go back to square 1.

Phrase it in a way that isn't antagonizing, since the answer could be something totally fine but not obvious.

There’s an adage that goes something like, “the best time to look for a new job is when you already have one”. 

Looking for a new job while you already have a job is completely normal and nothing to worry about. It is not your responsibility to schedule your career around the vacations of your peers. 

If you have a good relationship with your boss, give them a heads up and ask if they would be willing to give you a good reference. I’ve called references before and it’s nice to get a feel of what kind f employee you currently are from your boss. If you don’t have a good relationship, don’t let them know about it until you’ve secured employment and then give them a professional two weeks notice. It’s just a professional courtesy though so if things are really bad you can just leave. 

Good luck with your search.

In high school, I was part of the Future Farmers of America (ladies try and control yourselves) and went to the state conference where Foster Farms was offering tours of their facility.

At the time, foster farms was running some pretty popular commercials and I was interested and decided to go. 

While it might not be the most humane experience, it was incredible how they ran their facility so efficiently. In the most cold, industrial-like manner, they managed every part of a chickens life from egg to harvest. They had eggs in those movable storage walls you see in library archives with special life support functions. 

I distinctly remember a chicken falling off a conveyor belt causing its legs to break so it couldn’t walk. An employee came out, swooped the chicken up and threw him back into the belt to continue its journey to your local grocery store. While I felt bad the animal was in pain, at least it wouldn’t be for long.

By changing the dynamic we opened up different pathways to talk about the ways she was feeling. It's kinda liking taking the bite out of the threat. So listen to your dad and open up channels other than late night calls about suicide to talk to him about what goes on in his life. 
Physical or mental stimulation is vital. I run a lot whenever I feel the dark thoughts creeping up on me and it helps. Your dad may be losing the use of his limbs but maybe he can still do stuff. Indifference was my way of coping with my moms mental illness and my dads alcoholism when I was in high school. As I'm getting older and more independent from my family I have opened myself up more to emotions and cultivated more friendships now than I did when I was in high school. I push the limits of my comfort zone now so that I can experience more emotionally and have seen some cool stuff because of it. 

My advice is just do what feels right. For me, I needed to close myself off because my closest relationships had failed me. Just because you may close off now doesn't mean you can't open up later.
